app.account.create.description: Button that creates an account and uploads the progress on this device.

app.account.email.description: Label of the email address field.

app.account.have-account.description: Switches the account form to signing in.

app.account.new-account.description: Switches the account form to creating an account.

app.account.password-hint.description: Hint under the new-password field. $min is the minimum number of characters.

app.account.pitch.message: Create an account to keep your progress safe and use it on your other devices. Everything you've done so far comes with you.
app.account.pitch.description: Introduces the optional account. Accounts are never required.

app.account.sign-in.description: Button that signs in to an existing account.

app.account.sign-out.description: Button that signs out. Progress stays on this device.

app.account.signed-in.description: Who is signed in. $email is the account's email address.

app.account.welcome-back.message: Sign in to bring your progress from your other devices.

app.error.account.email-taken.message: There's already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
app.error.account.email-taken.description: Shown when creating an account with an email that has one.

app.error.account.invalid-email.description: Shown when the email address is not valid.

app.error.account.rejected.message: The server didn't accept some of your progress.
app.error.account.rejected.description: Shown when the server rejects uploaded events.

app.error.account.signed-out.message: You've been signed out. Sign in again to keep syncing.
app.error.account.signed-out.description: Shown when the server no longer accepts the saved sign-in.

app.error.account.unknown.description: Shown for unexpected account or sync errors.

app.error.account.unreachable.message: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
app.error.account.unreachable.description: Shown when the sync server cannot be reached.

app.error.account.weak-password.description: Shown when a new password is too short. $min is the minimum number of characters.

app.error.account.wrong-credentials.message: That email and password don't match.

app.error.load.message: This course could not be loaded.
app.error.load.description: Shown when a course bundle fails to load.

app.home.writing.description: Label of the choice between a course's orthographies (e.g. Latin or Cyrillic for Uzbek).

app.lessons.back.description: Link back to the course list.

app.lessons.lesson.description: Name of a lesson in the list. $number is its position.

app.lessons.new-words.description: Accessible label of the preview of words a lesson introduces.

app.lessons.title.description: Heading of a course's lesson list.

app.path.done.description: Status of a lesson the learner has completed. They can still open it to practise.

app.path.locked.description: Status of a lesson that opens once the lesson before it is done.

app.path.start.description: Status of the next lesson to do.

app.practice.back.description: Link from an empty practice session back to the course path.

app.practice.due.description: How many word facets are due for review. $count is a number.

app.practice.empty.description: Shown when a review or mistakes session has no exercises.

app.practice.mistakes.description: Button that starts a session of the learner's recent mistakes.

app.practice.review.description: Button that starts a review session of words that are due.

app.practice.title.description: Heading above the review and mistakes buttons.

app.practice.to-fix.description: How many recent mistakes are waiting in the mistakes session. $count is a number.

app.progress.device.message: Your progress is saved on this device.
app.progress.device.description: Where progress is kept when there is no account.

app.progress.export.description: Button that downloads every learning event recorded on this device.

app.progress.title.description: Heading of the progress and account section on the home screen.

app.store.memory.message: This browser window can't save your progress. It will be lost when you close it.
app.store.memory.description: Shown when on-device storage is unavailable (for example in some private windows).

app.sync.mismatch.message: The server's copy of your progress doesn't match this device's.
app.sync.mismatch.description: Shown when the server's projection of the log differs from the device's own.

app.sync.offline.description: Sync status while the server cannot be reached. $count is how many events wait to upload.

app.sync.pending.description: Sync status with events not yet uploaded. $count is a number.

app.sync.saved.message: All progress saved to your account
app.sync.saved.description: Sync status when everything is uploaded.

app.xp.today.description: Experience points earned today (the learner's local date). XP: experience points, often left as XP.

app.xp.total.description: Total experience points in this course. XP: experience points, often left as XP.

course.name.apc.description: Name of the Lebanese Arabic (apc) course, used inside other messages as $language. Not 'Levantine': the course teaches the Lebanese variety.

course.name.fa.description: Name of the Persian (fa) course, used inside other messages as $language.

course.name.uz.description: Name of the Uzbek (uz) course, used inside other messages as $language.

course.name.yue.description: Name of the Cantonese (yue) course, used inside other messages as $language.

exercise.action.check.description: Button that submits the answer for grading.

exercise.action.play-audio.description: Accessible label of the speaker button.

exercise.action.quit.description: Accessible label of the close (×) button in the lesson header.

exercise.action.skip.description: Button that skips the current exercise.

exercise.answer.input-label.description: Label of the free-text answer field. $language is a course name (course.name.*).

exercise.answer.label.description: Accessible label of the row where chosen word tiles appear.

exercise.instruction.write-in.description: Instruction for a translate-into-the-target-language exercise. $language is a course name (course.name.*).

exercise.progress.description: Accessible value of the lesson progress bar. $current and $total are counts.

exercise.prompt.label.description: Accessible label of the sentence the learner translates.

exercise.readings.toggle.description: Switch that shows or hides pronunciation guides (Jyutping, vowel marks) above the text.

exercise.wordbank.label.description: Accessible label of the group of word tiles to choose from.

exercise.wordbank.remaining.description: How many tiles are still in the word bank. $count is a number.

feedback.note.alef-maqsura.message: Watch the alif maqsura (ى) at the end of the word.
feedback.note.alef-maqsura.description: Feedback note for Arabic: alif maqsura and ya were confused.

feedback.note.apostrophe.message: In Uzbek, oʻ and gʻ take a turned comma (ʻ) and the separator sign is ʼ. A plain ' is fine to type, though.
feedback.note.apostrophe.description: Feedback note for Uzbek: the learner typed a plain apostrophe.

feedback.note.hamza.description: Feedback note for Arabic: a hamza seat was written as a plain alif.

feedback.note.hk-tw-variant.message: This is the Taiwan form of the character; Hong Kong usually writes it differently.
feedback.note.hk-tw-variant.description: Feedback note for Cantonese: a Taiwan character form was used where Hong Kong uses another.

feedback.note.ime-homophone.message: One character has the right sound but is the wrong character: check what your keyboard suggested.
feedback.note.ime-homophone.description: Feedback note for an IME slip (a homophone picked from the input method).

feedback.note.marks.message: Check the accents and vowel marks.
feedback.note.marks.description: Feedback note: the answer differs from the expected one only in marks.

feedback.note.pairs-mistakes.message: Some pairs took more than one try.
feedback.note.pairs-mistakes.description: Feedback note after match-pairs when some pairs were mismatched first.

feedback.note.script-mismatch.message: Check that you're writing in the right script.
feedback.note.script-mismatch.description: Generic feedback note: the answer is written in a different script from the course.

feedback.note.spacing.message: Watch the half-space (ZWNJ) inside this word.
feedback.note.spacing.description: Feedback note referenced by orthography profiles (match.zwnj.note = spacing) when the learner typed a space or nothing instead of a zero-width non-joiner.

feedback.note.ta-marbuta.message: Watch the ta marbuta (ة) at the end of the word.
feedback.note.ta-marbuta.description: Feedback note for Arabic: ta marbuta was written as ha.

feedback.note.tajik-letters.message: Use the Tajik letters ғ, ӣ, қ, ӯ, ҳ and ҷ.
feedback.note.tajik-letters.description: Feedback note for Tajik: Russian-keyboard letters were typed instead of Tajik ones.

feedback.note.use-traditional.description: Feedback note for Cantonese: the answer contains Simplified characters.

feedback.note.uzbek-letters.message: Use the Uzbek letters ў, қ, ғ and ҳ, not у, к, г and х.
feedback.note.uzbek-letters.description: Feedback note for Uzbek in Cyrillic: Russian-keyboard letters were typed instead of Uzbek ones.

feedback.note.variant.message: Another spelling of this character is more usual here.
feedback.note.variant.description: Feedback note: an accepted variant form was used.

feedback.note.zwnj.message: Watch the half-space (ZWNJ) inside this word.
feedback.note.zwnj.description: Generic feedback note when a zero-width non-joiner was typed as a space or left out.

feedback.verdict.correct.description: Feedback headline: the answer matched the expected one.

feedback.verdict.correct-alt.description: Feedback headline when the learner gave a correct answer other than the main one, which is shown after it.

feedback.verdict.correct-marks.message: Correct, but pay attention to the accents and marks.
feedback.verdict.correct-marks.description: Feedback headline: right apart from diacritics or vowel marks.

feedback.verdict.correct-provisional.message: Looks right! We'll double-check this one.
feedback.verdict.correct-provisional.description: Feedback headline: accepted provisionally by the AI judge; a human will review it.

feedback.verdict.correct-variant.message: Correct, but this form is spelled differently here.
feedback.verdict.correct-variant.description: Feedback headline: right, written with an accepted variant form (e.g. a Taiwan character form in a Hong Kong course).

feedback.verdict.correct-with-typo.description: Feedback headline: right apart from a small typing mistake.

feedback.verdict.partial.message: Almost: a character sounds right but is the wrong one.
feedback.verdict.partial.description: Feedback headline for an IME slip: a homophone was picked from the input method.

feedback.verdict.skipped.description: Feedback headline when the learner skipped the exercise.

feedback.verdict.wrong.description: Feedback headline: the answer is wrong. The correct answer is shown below it.

feedback.verdict.wrong-word.description: Feedback headline: one letter off, but the result is another real word.

orthography.apc-Arab.standard.description: Name of the Lebanese Arabic orthography in Arabic script.

orthography.apc-Latn.arabizi.description: Name of Arabizi, Lebanese Arabic written with Latin letters and digits (7 for ح, 3 for ع, 2 for ء).

orthography.fa-Arab.standard.description: Name of the Persian orthography (Arabic script as used for Persian).

orthography.uz-Cyrl.standard.description: Name of the Uzbek Cyrillic orthography.

orthography.uz-Latn.standard.description: Name of the Uzbek Latin orthography.

orthography.yue-Hant-HK.standard.description: Name of the Hong Kong Cantonese orthography.

player.action.cant-speak.description: Button that skips speaking exercises for the rest of the lesson.

player.action.continue.description: Button that moves on after feedback.

player.blank.label.description: Accessible label of the gap in a sentence.

player.chars.label.description: Accessible label of the bar of extra characters (ZWNJ, ʻ, ў…).

player.feedback.marked.description: Short explanation after the learner's marked answer: marked words or characters are the ones that differ. Not shown by colour alone.

player.feedback.solution.description: Label before the correct answer in feedback.

player.feedback.your-answer.description: Label before the learner's own answer, with the wrong parts marked.

player.finished.stopped.description: Heading when the learner quit the lesson.

player.finished.title.description: Heading when the lesson is finished.

player.finished.xp.description: Experience points the session just earned, on the summary screen.

player.instruction.char-read.description: Instruction: choose the reading (e.g. Jyutping) of the word shown.

player.instruction.choose-translation.description: Instruction: choose the translation of the sentence shown.

player.instruction.complete-translation.description: Instruction: type the missing word of the translation.

player.instruction.gap-fill.description: Instruction: choose the word that completes the sentence.

player.instruction.match-pairs.description: Instruction: match each word with its meaning.

player.instruction.reading-disambiguatio.message: How is the highlighted character read here?
player.instruction.reading-disambiguatio.description: Instruction: choose the reading a character with several readings has in this word.

player.instruction.select-image.description: Instruction: pick the picture (and word) that matches the meaning shown.

player.instruction.speak.description: Instruction for a speaking exercise (record yourself, then rate how it went).

player.instruction.translate-into-suppor.description: Instruction: build the translation of a target-language sentence from word tiles.

player.key.zwj.description: Accessible name of the ZWJ key. $short is the key's visible label (player.key.zwj.short) and must stay part of the name (WCAG 2.5.3).

player.key.zwj.short.description: Short visible label of the ZWJ key (the character itself is invisible).

player.key.zwnj.description: Accessible name of the ZWNJ key, which keeps two Persian letters from joining. $short is the key's visible label (player.key.zwnj.short) and must stay part of the name (WCAG 2.5.3).

player.key.zwnj.short.description: Short visible label of the ZWNJ key (the character itself is invisible).

player.options.label.description: Accessible label of the group of answer options.

player.pairs.meanings.description: Accessible label of the column of meanings in match-pairs.

player.pairs.words.description: Accessible label of the column of target-language words in match-pairs. $language is the course name.

player.prompt.hint.description: Accessible label of the support-language translation shown as a hint.

player.prompt.meaning.description: Accessible label of the meaning (gloss) the learner matches a picture to.

player.quit.body.message: You'll lose your progress in this lesson.

player.quit.cancel.description: Button that closes the quit dialog and goes back to the lesson.

player.quit.title.description: Title of the dialog shown when the learner closes a lesson.

player.speak.play.description: Button that plays back what the learner recorded.

player.speak.rate.description: Heading above the self-rating buttons (speak tier 0).

player.speak.rate.again.description: Self-rating: the learner could not say it.

player.speak.rate.good.description: Self-rating: the learner thinks they said it well.

player.speak.record.description: Button that starts recording the learner's voice.

player.speak.recording.description: Status while the microphone is recording.

player.speak.unavailable.message: Recording isn't available here. You can still say it aloud and rate yourself.
player.speak.unavailable.description: Shown when the browser cannot record audio.

player.toggle.marks.description: Switch that shows or hides harakat (Arabic-script vowel marks and shadda).

player.toggle.vertical.description: Switch that sets the sentence and word tiles top to bottom (CJK).

player.wordbank.answer-label.description: Accessible label of the row where the chosen tiles go.
